Our Services

Care, tailored to every pet

From full grooms to gentle puppy introductions, every appointment is one-to-one and unhurried — shaped around your pet, never rushed.

Full Groom & Style

The complete top-to-toe treatment — bath, blow-dry, cut and style, finished with nail care and a gentle ear clean, tailored to your dog's coat and character.

Bath & Blow-Dry

A soothing warm bath with premium pet-safe products, followed by a fluffy blow-dry and brush-out. The perfect refresh between full grooms.

Puppy's First Groom

A gentle introduction to grooming for young pups — short, positive sessions with plenty of praise, building confidence at their own pace.

Cat Grooming

Calm, patient grooming for cats — brush-outs, de-matting and coat care in a quiet setting, always handled entirely on your cat's terms.

Dog Walking

Unhurried walks full of sniffing, exploring and fresh air — solo or in small, carefully matched groups, tailored to your dog's energy.

Daycare & Play

A home-from-home day of play, rest and companionship — with photo updates, so you can see exactly how much fun they're having.

One-to-one, alwaysYour pet has our undivided attention
About Pawchester

Personalised care, never one-size-fits-all

Pawchester was founded on a simple belief: pets are family, and they should be cared for that way. No conveyor belts, no rushed appointments — just calm, attentive care shaped around the animal in front of us.

Whether it's a full groom, a first puppy pamper or a quiet afternoon of daycare, we take the time to learn what makes your pet comfortable — their favourite scratches, their nervous spots, their little routines — and we remember them for next time.

  • Care plans tailored to each pet
  • Calm, one-to-one appointments
  • Gentle handling for nervous pets
  • Dogs & cats of every size

Good to Know

Questions, answered

Simply complete the booking enquiry form above with your details, your pet and your preferred date. We'll be in touch to confirm the appointment and talk through everything your pet needs.

First visits are deliberately unhurried. Your pet gets time to explore, sniff and settle before anything begins, and we check their coat, skin and temperament so the session can be shaped entirely around them.

It depends on your pet's size, coat condition and how relaxed they are — we never rush. We'll give you an estimate when your appointment is confirmed, and let you know as soon as your pet is ready to be collected.

Yes — cats are very welcome at Pawchester. Cat appointments are kept quiet and calm, and every session is led by your cat: if they need a break, they get one.

Absolutely. One-to-one appointments, a calm environment and plenty of patience are exactly what nervous pets need. Tell us about your pet in your enquiry and we'll plan their visit together.

Prices depend on your pet's size, coat and the service you choose. We'll always confirm the full cost with you before your appointment — no surprises, ever.
